namespace = test
# The first event
test.1 = {
	type = character_event
	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = duel_target
		trigger_event = test.2
		trigger_event = { id = test.3 }
		my_trig = { TARGET = root }
		add_gold = 10
	}
	option = { name = test.1.a }
}
test.2 = { type = character_event }
scripted_effect my_inline = {
	add_prestige = $AMOUNT$
	add_gold = $AMOUNT$
}
